create_FunctionalTensorMode: create a FunctionalTensorMode context manager to enable functionalization that removes mutations from tensor operations
wrap_tensor_to_functional: wrap a real tensor into a FunctionalTensor using FunctionalTensor.to_functional to enable mutation-free dispatch
unwrap_tensor_from_functional: unwrap a FunctionalTensor back to a regular tensor using FunctionalTensor.from_functional after functionalization completes
dispatch_functionalize: dispatch a function through functionalization using dispatch_functionalize to remove all in-place mutations
use_PythonFunctionalizeAPI: use PythonFunctionalizeAPI to wrap, functionalize, and unwrap tensors with a Python-based functionalization pipeline
